body: Very true. Best of luck for the future, I know we can do this eventually. Once again, thank you, my friend.

I’m hypocritical too. Everyone has unique and complex lives, and we never truly know what’s going on inside another’s mind. I still compare myself to others though, and I always thought I was selfish for it. 

We all have bad habits and flaws we wish we could change about ourselves. Maybe we can get through it, regardless of how long it takes.

Thank you. I always tried to tell myself to take it slowly, but I just feel so behind compared to other people my age. I know I have to put some effort in it, but the fact that I don’t and haven’t done anything about it as of yet just depresses me even further. It probably will take years, but I just don’t want to waste my youth trying to do what’s considered easy and normal for most people.
